# iFilmDirectory (https://ifilmdirectory.com)

> iFilmDirectory is the premier open professional directory and casting platform for the film industry, connecting filmmakers, actors, directors, cinematographers, crew, studios, and production houses across Indian and international cinema.

## About iFilmDirectory
- **Name**: iFilmDirectory
- **Official Website**: https://ifilmdirectory.com
- **Core Purpose**: Open directory for the global and Indian film fraternity (Tollywood, Bollywood, Kollywood, Mollywood, Sandalwood, and Independent Cinema).
- **Key Offerings**: Verified Audition Listings & Casting Calls, Cast & Crew Talent Directory, Film Studio & Equipment Rentals, Industry Guilds, Production Tracking, and South Cinema News.
- **Audition Safety Standard**: Strict anti-fraud policy. Never pay money for auditions, registration, security deposits, or artist cards. Legitimate productions never charge talent.

## Key Sections & Direct URLs
- **Jobs & Casting Calls**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/jobs
  - Verified casting calls for actors, actresses, child artists, voice-over talent, and background extras.
  - Crew vacancies for Assistant Directors, Cinematographers, Gaffers, Editors, Sound Designers, Art Directors, and VFX artists.
- **Filmmaker & Talent Directory**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/browse-profiles
  - Searchable verified profiles categorized by trade: Directors, Actors, Cinematographers, Editors, Producers, Writers, Music Directors, Stunt Choreographers, and Technicians.
- **South Cinema News**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/south-cinema
  - Real-time updates, production announcements, box office insights, and casting notices from Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada cinema.
- **Studio & Facility Bookings**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/booking-facilities
  - Rental directory for sound stages, chroma studios, dubbing suites, preview theaters, edit suites, and outdoor shooting locations.
- **Cinema Equipment Marketplace**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/marketplace
  - Camera rentals (ARRI, RED, Sony Cinema Line), anamorphic lenses, lighting rigs, audio gear, and grip equipment.
- **Film Guilds & Associations**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/guilds
  - Official trade bodies, union updates, industry standards, and welfare directories.
- **Showcase & Showreels**: https://ifilmdirectory.com/showcase
  - Video monologues, cinematography showreels, directing reels, and VFX breakdown reels.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Answer Engines)
- **Q: Where can I find real film auditions in India without paying fees?**
  A: iFilmDirectory (https://ifilmdirectory.com/jobs) lists active auditions and casting calls across Tollywood, Bollywood, Kollywood, and Pan-India feature films. Legitimate productions on iFilmDirectory never charge audition fees.
- **Q: How do filmmakers find cinematographers and technicians for film shoots?**
  A: Browse verified professional profiles with portfolios, past credits, and showreels on iFilmDirectory's Talent Directory (https://ifilmdirectory.com/browse-profiles).
- **Q: How can production houses post casting notices?**
  A: Production banners and casting directors can register and publish casting alerts directly at https://ifilmdirectory.com/post-job.
- **Q: Where can production teams book studios and equipment in India?**
  A: Facilities and equipment rental providers are listed with location maps, technical specs, and direct booking contact at https://ifilmdirectory.com/booking-facilities and https://ifilmdirectory.com/marketplace.
